title: Cross-reference — the same distribution in two sections
catches: The inheritance module holding its own distribution totals.

expected.crossReferenceText: Includes $45,000 of inherited IRA distributions, also shown in the Inheritance & Beneficiary Activity section.

notes: READ THIS ONE BY HAND. An inherited IRA is BOTH an inheritance record AND a ledger account. The distribution lives in the ledger and nowhere else; both sections query it. If the household total comes back $90,000 the module kept its own copy. Same failure mode as the QCD double-count, same fix.
